name: shikanime-labs/skills
description: A curated catalog of self-improved agent skills for Hermes and compatible agents: two parallel org workflows (shikanime sks-*, cloud-pi-native cpn-*) covering the full discussion, issue, and PR lifecycle, with proven-done gates, assumption validation, jj-workspace parallel fan-out, and stacked PR landing.

skills.name: sks-adversarial
skills.description: Use when probing uncertain results in a disposable sandbox — large investigation, development, debugging, testing, UAT, white-room, or data validation before promoting a change.

skills.name: sks-async
skills.description: Use when splitting multi-unit work into parallel, isolated jj workspaces (depth-tree fan-out) and landing as independent plain `gh pr` merges.

skills.name: sks-bulk
skills.description: Use when applying one instruction to many targets — repos, issues, PRs, orgs, or any enumerable agentic batch: enumerate targets, drive the batch from a plan file, and verify every result.

skills.name: sks-commit
skills.description: Use when committing in a target-org repo: plain-English imperative titles and repo-enforced hooks (gitlint, DCO) win.

skills.name: sks-converge
skills.description: Use when jj conflicts or divergent changes block a jj repo after a tree move — resolve conflicted revisions and divergent twins until pushable.

skills.name: sks-curate
skills.description: Use when updating, improving, compressing, or token-optimizing a skill or profile in a skills catalog: rework the body, tighten it, refresh evals, and keep it loadable.

skills.name: sks-delegate
skills.description: Use when isolating one unit of work in a fresh jj workspace — the mandatory entry to implementation for every unit, so concurrent WIP never folds in and bookmarks/pushes stay scoped.

skills.name: sks-dev
skills.description: Use when running the local dev loop in a target org's repos: branching in a fresh jj workspace, push-to-origin, jj bookmark tracking, and landing via plain gh pr merge or direct push.

skills.name: sks-discussion
skills.description: Use when opening an RFC Discussion in the target org as the pre-issue stage: converge on the problem, then derive the issue.

skills.name: sks-discussion-triage
skills.description: Use when triaging an existing org discussion: category, body shape, Q&A answer, and conversion to an issue.

skills.name: sks-doc
skills.description: Use when documenting a project in the repo's docs/ directory after a behavior-changing PR.

skills.name: sks-evolve
skills.description: Use when evolving the agent substrate without a hand-named target: mine experience for signals, evolve skills, profiles, memory, conventions, cron, or config, and repeat the fitness loop.

skills.name: sks-fastlane
skills.description: Use when a hotfix, small update, or insignificant chore is too trivial for the full gate train: merge its PR without human review once CI is green.

skills.name: sks-gc
skills.description: Use when reclaiming resources leaked by jj-based agent workflows — dangling bookmarks, skill-created jj workspaces, and leftover working-copy dirs from sks-async/sks-dev.

skills.name: sks-github-text-authoring
skills.description: Use when writing any GitHub text in the target org's repos — commit message, issue or PR body, discussion RFC, review or issue comment. Owns all shared prose rules; surface skills handle procedure.

skills.name: sks-investigate
skills.description: Use when investigating a bug, test failure, build break, or unexpected behavior — find root cause, form a hypothesis, and propose a solution, never apply the fix itself.

skills.name: sks-issue
skills.description: Use when opening an issue in an org repo: body is the problem statement, acceptance criteria as a command-decidable tasklist.

skills.name: sks-issue-refine
skills.description: Use when iterating a problem to convergence inside its GitHub issue via research and comments before deriving the PR.

skills.name: sks-issue-triage
skills.description: Use when triaging an existing org issue: assign type, labels, assignee, milestone, project, relationships, and fields; close with rationale if not workable.

skills.name: sks-issue-workflow
skills.description: Use when you need the single entry point for the issue side: create, refine, and triage the issue before any PR.

skills.name: sks-land
skills.description: Use when landing a target-org PR after reconciliation (sks-pr-resolve) and review approval gates pass; closes the linked issue deliberately.

skills.name: nixpkgs-pr-review
skills.description: Use when reviewing an upstream NixOS/nixpkgs pull request: build the changed packages with nixpkgs-review and check the diff against nixpkgs conventions.

skills.name: sks-kubernetes-manifests-authoring
skills.description: Use when authoring or editing Kubernetes manifests or kustomize overlays in a GitOps repo: placement, patches, generators, labels, probes, and live-cluster cross-checks.

skills.name: sks-moderation
skills.description: Use when hiding, unhiding, or moderating comments on GitHub issues, PRs, or discussions with the Hide feature: classifier choice, GraphQL mutations, verification.

skills.name: sks-pr
skills.description: Use when opening a PR in a target-org repo: push to origin, --head org:branch, plain-English title, issue linkage, parity with commit.

skills.name: sks-pr-resolve
skills.description: Use when resolving a PR's review conversations, including CodeRabbit review comments, checking the DoD ledger, and reconciling before merge (no merge itself).

skills.name: sks-pr-review
skills.description: Use when reviewing code in an org repo: cross-check related issues, enforce YAGNI, root-cause fixes, and project conventions before approval.

skills.name: sks-pr-triage
skills.description: Use when triaging an existing org PR: labels, assignee, milestone, and reviewers.

skills.name: sks-pr-workflow
skills.description: Use when you need the single entry point for the org PR side: ensure the issue exists, open, and triage the PR. Land separately via sks-land.

skills.name: sks-project
skills.description: Use when tracking issue/PR advancement on an org board: resolve the board from context or provision one, set Status to the real phase, audit drift.

skills.name: cpn-release-patch
skills.description: Use when backporting the commits between two release tags onto a hotfix branch in <org>/<repo>: find the patch milestone and duplicate those commits onto the tag with jj.

skills.name: sks-restack
skills.description: Use when rebasing a jj stack onto moved main leaves conflicts — restack, then resolve each conflicted revision with edit/resolve until pushable.

skills.name: sks-split
skills.description: Use when one jj commit or in-flight stack has grown multiple responsibilities and must be split into parallel sibling units or a parent/child stack, decided per unit pair by dependency.

skills.name: sks-nix-authoring
skills.description: Use when authoring or editing Nix in an org repo: nixfmt-sorted style, single-use let bindings, no explanatory comments, YAGNI on new options.

skills.name: sks-skill-authoring
skills.description: Use when creating a brand-new skill or profile for a skills catalog: grounded body, evals, manifests, and ship through the dev workflow.

skills.name: sks-sops-secrets-authoring
skills.description: Use when editing sops-encrypted files: decrypt-and-edit workflow, re-encryption guards, and sops-nix secret plumbing.

skills.name: sks-swarm
skills.description: Use when distributing a task across a cluster of agents over A2A — route by capability need, machine resource, and runner pressure, optionally in a disposable sks-adversarial sandbox.

skills.name: sks-sudo
skills.description: Use when a gh operation must run under a different org identity: lock, switch to the agent account, confirm the flip, restore the operator.

skills.name: sks-ts-authoring
skills.description: Use when writing or reviewing TypeScript: parse-don't-validate boundaries, cast-free explicit types, linear single-purpose functions, and schema-first inputs.

skills.name: sks-repo
skills.description: Use when creating a new org repo: apply the 5-ruleset protection template, bootstrap the devlib devenv scaffold, and tag v0.1.0.

skills.name: sks-triage
skills.description: Use when triaging a target org, repo, issue, or PR: sweep the scope for untriaged items, then assign every empty, context-derivable field — type, labels, assignee, fields.

skills.name: sks-update
skills.description: Use when updating skills or profiles in a skills catalog: curate every skill by default (or named ones only), land through the dev workflow, and resync to local Hermes agents.
